challenge.results: The bound sets the direction-dependent limit and need not itself lie on the progression. The two-expression version has a default step of one. The comparison with the set former does not license any set traversal-order inference.

limitations: The claim describes the specified step and bound for an integer tuple former. It does not give error recovery, expression evaluation order, or additional results for degenerate bounds.
